---
title: "Visualizza Record"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/css/dataTables.bootstrap5.min.css">
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/js/dataTables.bootstrap5.min.js"></script>
          <script src="view-data.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<div class="container-fluid px-1 py-1">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-12">

<div class="card border-0 rounded-3">
<div class="card-header bg-primary text-white border-0 py-3">
<h5 class="mb-0"><i class="bi bi-table"></i> Elenco Record</h5>
</div>

<div class="card-body p-0">
<div id="loading" class="text-center py-5">
  <div class="spinner-border text-primary" role="status">
    <span class="visually-hidden">Caricamento...</span>
  </div>
  <p class="mt-3 text-muted">Caricamento...</p>
</div>

<div id="error-message" class="alert alert-danger m-3 border-0 rounded-3" style="display: none;"></div>

<div id="table-container" class="table-responsive" style="display: none;">
  <table id="recordTable" class="table table-striped table-hover mb-0">
    <thead class="table-light">
      <tr>
        <th class="small">Data/Ora</th>
        <th class="small">Nome</th>
        <th class="small">Importo</th>
        <th class="small">Nota</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
</div>

<style>
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  #recordTable {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #recordTable th,
  #recordTable td {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem;
  }
}
</style>
```
